CVE-2026-135107.text: An **uncontrolled memory allocation** flaw has been found in the smbd_smb2_ioctl_pipe_write_done() function in source3/smbd/smb2_ioctl_named_pipe.c of the SMB2 named-pipe ioctl handling in the samba package. The file server reserves memory for a named-pipe response using a size chosen by the client. It does not keep that size within the maximum the client and the server have already agreed. A low-privileged network attacker or user who can open a named pipe can request a very large response. The file server reserves that memory before it reads the pipe and holds it until the request ends. Repeating this on more connections can exhaust memory and keep the file service unavailable while those requests continue.

CVE-2026-137596.text: A server-side request forgery (SSRF) flaw was found in KubeVirt's decentralized live migration. The connectURL field of a VirtualMachineInstanceMigration object is not validated at admission, and the privileged synchronization-controller dials the attacker-specified URL. Connection and DNS errors from the dial are exposed in a condition readable in the tenant's namespace. A user with the kubevirt.io:migrate role (a role designed for tenant delegation) can use this behavior as a blind network-reconnaissance oracle to determine the existence and connectivity of internal hosts and ports from the controller's network vantage, including services isolated from the tenant by network policy. TLS certificate pinning prevents session completion with non-KubeVirt hosts, limiting the impact to information disclosure of internal network topology; no data content, integrity, or availability impact is possible.

On hosts with sufficient free memory, the same technique can instead hold large amounts of memory per connection. Exploitation requires network access to the SPICE port; credential requirements depend on the server's authentication configuration.

CVE-2026-135279.text: @fastify/express is the plugin that lets an application run Express middleware and Express applications inside the Fastify web framework. In versions before 4.0.14, a request with an empty dynamic route parameter reaches a Fastify route handler while middleware mounted for that path inside an Express Router or sub-application is skipped, because Fastify's router accepts an empty value where Express requires a non-empty one, and an unanchored regular-expression mount passed to the plugin is bypassed the same way. An earlier fix covered only the mount paths passed to the plugin directly, not middleware mounted inside a routed Express application. An attacker can use this to bypass authentication or other middleware-based access controls on the affected routes, with the practical impact depending on what the empty value selects in the application. The issue is fixed in @fastify/express 4.0.14, and users should upgrade to 4.0.14 or later. As a workaround, enforce authentication in a Fastify hook such as preHandler that runs after routing, mount the middleware on a static parent path, or require non-empty values in the route params schema.

CVE-2026-135230.text: @fastify/express is the plugin that lets an application run Express middleware and Express applications inside the Fastify web framework. In versions from 4.0.3 before 4.0.14, the plugin decodes certain percent-encoded characters in the request path that Express would otherwise keep encoded, including the Unicode line separator and paragraph separator characters, and leaves them raw. An attacker can use this to bypass authentication or other middleware-based access controls on routes guarded by a regular-expression mount; string mount paths are not affected. The issue is fixed in @fastify/express 4.0.14, and users should upgrade to 4.0.14 or later. CVE-2026-135264.text: @fastify/express is the plugin that lets an application run Express middleware and Express applications inside the Fastify web framework. In versions from 4.0.7 before 4.0.14, when middleware is mounted on a nested array of mount paths the plugin rewrites only the top level of the array, so paths inside a nested array are not adjusted for a plugin registered under a prefix and the middleware never runs for them, a nested regular-expression mount keeps its global or sticky flag and is matched statefully so it is skipped on alternating requests, a nested regular expression is not matched case-insensitively when case sensitivity is disabled, and nested dynamic paths are not covered by the earlier empty-segment check. An attacker can use any of these to bypass authentication or other middleware-based access controls on the affected routes. The issue is fixed in @fastify/express 4.0.14, and users should upgrade to 4.0.14 or later. As a workaround, flatten mount path arrays before passing them to the plugin, or enforce authentication in a Fastify hook such as preHandler that runs after the router resolves the request.

CVE-2026-135270.text: @fastify/express is the plugin that lets an application run Express middleware and Express applications inside the Fastify web framework. In versions from 4.0.5 before 4.0.14, a mount path that begins with an Express 5 optional leading segment written as a group is treated as relative and has a slash prepended when it is joined to the plugin prefix, which changes what the pattern matches so the middleware ends up mounted on a path that no longer corresponds to the real request paths. The middleware therefore never runs for requests that match the intended routes, while the Fastify routes still resolve to their handlers. An attacker can use this to bypass authentication or other middleware-based access controls on the affected routes. The issue is fixed in @fastify/express 4.0.14, and users should upgrade to 4.0.14 or later. As a workaround, mount the middleware on each path spelling explicitly, or enforce authentication in a Fastify hook such as preHandler that runs after the router resolves the request.

CVE-2026-102001.text: The wpForo Forum plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'nickname / display_name (via WP core profile form); thread[body] carries the [quote data-userid=..] trigger' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.2.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. CVE-2026-135205.text: @fastify/middie is the plugin that adds Express-style middleware support to the Fastify web framework. In versions 9.3.6 through 9.3.9, a route or mount path written without a leading slash inside a plugin registered under a prefix is handled inconsistently: the middleware is mounted with a separating slash after the prefix, while the route is concatenated directly onto the prefix, so a request to the concatenated path reaches the route handler without running the middleware mounted for it. An attacker can use this to bypass authentication or other middleware-based access controls on the affected routes. The issue is fixed in @fastify/middie 9.3.10, and users should upgrade to 9.3.10 or later. As a workaround, begin all route and mount paths with a slash, or enforce authentication in a Fastify hook such as preHandler that runs after the router resolves the request.

CVE-2026-85412.text: The Easy Form Builder by WhiteStudio – Drag & Drop Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'address' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.2.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. CVE-2026-85416.text: The Lenix Leads Collector plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Form Field Name in all versions up to, and including, 2.0.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is exploitable because the plugin's CF7 integration accepts and stores any extra field name not defined in the CF7 form — including HTML/JS payloads — submitted by an unauthenticated user via a public CF7 form submission, with the raw field name later echoed unescaped in two separate admin-side sinks.

CVE-2026-90962.text: The WebP Express plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authorization Bypass via Malformed Bcrypt Salt in all versions up to, and including, 0.25.15. This is due to insufficient validation of the attacker-supplied `salt` POST parameter in the `runAccessChecks()` function, which passes the unvalidated salt directly to PHP's `crypt()` — causing it to return an empty string when the salt contains characters outside the valid bcrypt alphabet `[./0-9A-Za-z]` — and then loosely compares the resulting empty string against the attacker-controlled `api-key-crypted` POST parameter using `==`, allowing an empty submission to match and satisfy the check. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to bypass the web service API-key authentication check and upload arbitrary image files to the cloud-conversion endpoint, where they persist at a predictable, publicly reachable path under `wp-content/webp-express/webp-images/wpc/`. The 'Require api-key to be crypted in transfer?' whitelist setting does not mitigate this bypass, as it only gates the plaintext API-key comparison branch and has no effect on the crypted-key branch containing the vulnerable logic.

CVE-2026-92251.text: The ZarinPal Payment Gateway for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference in versions up to, and including, 5.1.1 via the `Return_from_ZarinPal_Gateway()` handler registered on the `woocommerce_api_wc_zpal` (`?wc-api=wc_zpal`) endpoint. The handler accepts a `wc_order` parameter from the query string, loads the corresponding WooCommerce order without any authentication, nonce, session, capability, or ownership check, and — when the order is paid — issues a 302 redirect to `get_return_url($order)`, whose `Location` header embeds the order's secret `order_key`. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to harvest order keys for arbitrary orders (regardless of payment method) and then use those keys against the WooCommerce order-received, order-pay and download endpoints to read the associated customer's PII, including billing name, street address, phone number, email, purchased items, and totals.

CVE-2026-97345.text: The SumUp Payment Gateway For WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference in versions up to, and including, 2.17.1 via the 'sumup-validate-order' query parameter handled by the check_redirect_flow() / resolve_payment_redirect_validation() functions. The template_redirect handler accepts an arbitrary numeric order ID from an unauthenticated GET request and, without any ownership or capability check, loads the corresponding WooCommerce order and issues a 302 redirect whose Location header is built by get_return_url(), disclosing the target order's secret order_key. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to enumerate order IDs, harvest each order's WooCommerce order_key, and use those keys against the plugin's create_checkout endpoint and WooCommerce's own order-received/order-pay pages to read customer PII (name, email, phone, billing address, order total) for any order in the store.

CVE-2026-137579.text: Web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.x before 4.0.9, 4.1.x before 4.1.11, and 4.2.x before 4.2.6, and jwt-core through 3.2.10, perform unblinded RSA private key operations in RSAKey::exponentiate(), so CRT recombination time reveals whether a decrypted RSA-OAEP, RSA-OAEP-256, or RSA1_5 value is below the prime q. Attackers who can submit JWEs can time rejections of crafted tokens to binary search q, factor the modulus, and decrypt all JWEs encrypted to that key.

CVE-2026-137580.text: web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.x before 4.0.9, 4.1.x before 4.1.11, and 4.2.x before 4.2.6 parse JSON General serialized JWS tokens in quadratic time because JSONGeneralSerializer::unserialize() adds each signature via JWS::addSignature(), which clones the token. Unauthenticated remote attackers can send large tokens holding thousands of empty signatures to exhaust CPU and occupy PHP workers without any valid key or token.

CVE-2026-137581.text: web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.x before 4.0.9, 4.1.x before 4.1.11, and 4.2.x before 4.2.6, and jwt-encryption and jwt-signature through 3.2.10, contain a denial of service vulnerability because the JWS and JWE serializers pass attacker-controlled tokens and protected headers to json_decode() without bounds before verification. Unauthenticated attackers can submit large tokens with colliding header member names or deeply nested arrays to cause quadratic decoding time or fatal memory exhaustion.

CVE-2026-137582.text: web-token jwt-framework before 3.4.13, 4.0.x before 4.0.9, 4.1.x before 4.1.11, and 4.2.x before 4.2.6 allows denial of service because JWELoader and JWSLoader try every recipient or signature of a JSON General serialized token without limiting their number. Unauthenticated attackers can send a small JWE with many empty recipients inheriting a maximal PBES2 p2c value, forcing repeated key derivations that exhaust worker CPU.

CVE-2026-76075.text: The Warehouse Cargo theme for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Upload in versions up to, and including, 2.7.4 via the warehouse_cargo_install_and_activate_plugin() AJAX handler. The handler is registered on wp_ajax_ but performs no nonce verification and no capability check, allowing any authenticated user to supply an attacker-controlled URL that the server fetches, writes into wp-content/plugins/ with file_put_contents(), extracts with unzip_file() (which does not filter file extensions), and then activates via activate_plugin(). This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to upload arbitrary files on the affected site's server which makes remote code execution possible.

CVE-2026-137559.text: web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.x before 4.0.9, 4.1.x before 4.1.11, and 4.2.x before 4.2.6 allow CPU exhaustion because, on PHP without GMP, AbstractECDH falls back to pure PHP curve code that converts unbounded ECDH-ES epk x and y coordinates to big integers before any length check. Unauthenticated attackers who know only the recipient key's curve can send small JWEs with oversized epk coordinates, keeping workers busy for seconds to minutes per token.

CVE-2026-137560.text: Web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.x before 4.0.9, 4.1.x before 4.1.11, and 4.2.x before 4.2.6 contain a denial of service vulnerability in RSAKey, which accepts RSA keys with a modulus and public exponent of unbounded length. Remote attackers can supply a crafted key, such as in the jwk header of a DPoP proof, to force seconds of CPU per PS256/PS384/PS512 verification or RSA encryption, or per any RSA operation when GMP is unavailable.

CVE-2026-137561.text: Web-Token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.0 before 4.0.9, 4.1.0 before 4.1.11, and 4.2.0 before 4.2.6, and jwt-encryption through 3.2.10, contain a token malleability flaw because JWEDecrypter does not reject a non-empty JWE Encrypted Key with the dir, ECDH-ES and ECDH-SS algorithms, which the authentication tag does not cover. Attackers holding one token can fill the Encrypted Key with arbitrary bytes to derive unlimited distinct token strings that still decrypt, bypassing replay caches, single-use registries or revocation deny-lists keyed on the token string.

CVE-2026-137562.text: web-token jwt-framework before 3.4.13, 4.0.0 before 4.0.9, 4.1.0 before 4.1.11, and 4.2.0 before 4.2.6 does not check oct key length in the AESKW, AESGCMKW, and experimental AESCTR and chacha20-poly1305 key encryption algorithms, so OpenSSL zero-pads short or empty keys. When an application uses an empty key, anyone can unwrap content encryption keys under the all-zero key to read issued tokens and forge accepted ones.

CVE-2026-137563.text: web-token jwt-framework from 4.2.1 before 4.2.6 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that exposes decryption keys in exception stack traces when JWE tokens are rejected. Attackers can submit crafted JWE tokens so JWELoader and JWEDecrypter record dir, AES key wrapping, PBES2-derived or content encryption keys in logged trace arguments readable by others.

CVE-2026-137564.text: web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.x before 4.0.9, 4.1.x before 4.1.11, and 4.2.x before 4.2.6 (and jwt-encryption through 3.2.10) do not check the key length in JWEBuilder and JWEDecrypter for direct (dir) encryption, so undersized keys are zero-padded. Anyone holding a token issued with a half-size AES-CBC-HMAC key can decrypt it, and an empty key also allows forging tokens the decrypter accepts.

CVE-2026-137552.text: Frappe Framework before 15.121.1 and 16.x before 16.35.0 accepts an undocumented OAuth2 Resource Owner Password Credentials (password) grant at its token endpoint, which does not enforce two-factor authentication or forced password resets. CVE-2026-137555.text: Frappe Framework before 15.119.0 and 16.x before 16.32.0 does not neutralize spreadsheet formula elements in user-supplied data included in CSV and XLSX exports, resulting in stored formula injection. CVE-2026-137556.text: Dockhand before 1.0.57 contains a path traversal vulnerability in validateStackPath, which omits the isProtectedPath() check and permits writes to protected system directories. Authenticated users with stacks:edit permission can send a crafted composePath to PUT /api/stacks/[name]/compose to write arbitrary files, such as cron payloads, achieving remote code execution as root.

CVE-2026-137557.text: SunEditor from 3.0.0 before 3.4.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the codeBlock plugin that allows attackers to inject script via entity-encoded pre language class values. CVE-2026-137558.text: web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.0 before 4.0.9, 4.1.0 before 4.1.11, and 4.2.0 before 4.2.6 contain a decryption oracle in RSACrypt::decryptWithRSAOAEP(), which accepts a JWE Encrypted Key made of multiple RSA blocks instead of a single RSAES-OAEP ciphertext. Attackers holding the recipient's public key can embed a captured encrypted key among crafted blocks and, using an accepted AES-CBC-HMAC algorithm and a decryption success signal, recover its CEK byte by byte to decrypt the captured JWE.

CVE-2026-137550.text: Frappe Framework before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in Document.update() that fails to validate whether the caller is permitted to submit or modify the target document. Attackers can invoke document update operations to submit or alter documents they are not authorized to change.

CVE-2026-137547.text: Coder before 2.29.27, 2.30.0 before 2.34.19, 2.35.0 before 2.37.11, 2.38.0 before 2.38.7, and 2.39.0 before 2.39.1 returns database connection errors containing a temporary AWS IAM database password in API key middleware responses. CVE-2026-137551.text: Frappe Framework before 15.121.2 and 16.x before 16.36.0 exposes functions imported into module-path-hooked modules as Jinja globals, making them callable from sandboxed templates. CVE-2026-137542.text: LaraDashboard before 1.5.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in SettingObserver that writes full Setting models, including plaintext secret option_value fields, into the action_logs table. CVE-2026-137543.text: LaraDashboard before 1.5.2 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to reach internal services by abusing the unvalidated ai_ollama_base_url setting. CVE-2026-137545.text: Coder 2.9.0 before 2.29.27, 2.30.0 before 2.34.12, 2.35.0 before 2.35.9, 2.36.0 before 2.36.7, and 2.37.0 before 2.37.3 contains a nil pointer dereference in the tailnet coordinator, which reads UpdateSelf.Node fields during authorization without checking that Node is set. An authenticated user or workspace agent token holder can send a CoordinateRequest with UpdateSelf present but Node empty to crash coderd, disconnecting all users on the affected replica.

CVE-2026-137546.text: Coder 2.29.17 before 2.29.27, 2.32.7 before 2.33.0, 2.33.8 before 2.34.0, 2.34.2 before 2.34.19, 2.35.0 before 2.37.11, 2.38.0 before 2.38.7, and 2.39.0 before 2.39.1 contains a credential exposure vulnerability that allows malicious template authors to steal session tokens because coder open app substitutes $SESSION_TOKEN into template-defined external app URLs without validating scheme or destination. Attackers can define an external app URL or IDE link pointing to an attacker server so users running coder open app leak their token, enabling impersonation of shared users or administrators.

CVE-2026-137536.text: ToolJet before 3.21.94-beta contains an authentication bypass in its server OAuth SSO sign-in module, which resolves Google and Git SSO logins solely by the provider-asserted email without checking email_verified or binding the SSO subject. Unauthenticated attackers can submit a trusted-issuer token carrying a victim's unverified email to the SSO callback to obtain the victim's session, including admin accounts.

CVE-2026-137534.text: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows low-privilege app/query viewers to obtain plaintext workspace secrets by running REST queries. Attackers can execute queries via POST /data-queries/:id/run whose URL params or non-redacted headers reference secrets, reading resolved values from metadata.request despite lacking decrypted constants access.

CVE-2026-137535.text: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privilege users to recover plaintext workspace secret constants through OAuth URL generation. Attackers can send POST /api/data-sources/fetch-oauth2-base-url with {{secrets.*}} in source_options and arbitrary organization_id and environment_id to receive secrets, including other workspaces' secrets, in the returned authorization URL.

CVE-2026-137537.text: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated End Users to execute data queries of apps in other organizations via POST /api/data-queries/:id/run. Attackers can supply a target data-query id and runtime resolvedOptions to run queries with the datasource's decrypted credentials, reading cross-tenant query results.

CVE-2026-137538.text: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an insufficient session expiration vulnerability that allows attackers to reuse expired JWTs because the passport-jwt strategy sets ignoreExpiration to true. Attackers holding a leaked tj_auth_token can keep sessions alive through auto-extended expiry and two-year cookies to persistently access victim accounts.

CVE-2026-137540.text: Tornado before 6.6.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in StaticFileHandler on Windows that allows unauthenticated attackers to read NTFS Alternate Data Streams by appending :streamname to URL paths. Attackers can request stream paths that pass the get_absolute_path and _check_in_root prefix checks to read hidden stream content, such as stored secrets or Zone.Identifier source data.

CVE-2026-137526.text: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authorization bypass in the internal database (TJDB) PostgREST proxy, which grants proxy access to every logged-in user and derives the database role and schema from the client-supplied tj-workspace-id header. Any authenticated workspace member can send requests to /api/tooljet-db/proxy/ to read and modify TJDB tables, bypassing app, query, and table permissions, and in SQL-mode-disabled (Cloud) deployments can access all tenants' tables.

CVE-2026-137527.text: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a cross-workspace authorization bypass in the organization-users archive and unarchive endpoints, which take the target organizationId from the request body without validating it against the caller's authorized workspaces. An admin of any workspace who knows a target organization-user ID and workspace UUID can archive or unarchive users in other tenants' workspaces, locking them out of those workspaces and tampering with the audit trail.

CVE-2026-137528.text: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated same-organization users to invoke OAuth2 authorization on data sources they cannot configure. Attackers can send POST requests to /api/data-sources/:id/authorize_oauth2 to bind attacker-controlled OAuth credentials or overwrite token state for foreign data sources.

CVE-2026-137530.text: ToolJet before 3.21.94-beta contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in getVersionsByEnvironment that allows authenticated users to read another organization's application versions due to missing organizationId scoping. Attackers can request the app-environments versions route with their own priority-1 production environment id and a victim app_id to retrieve the victim's version list and structure.

CVE-2026-137531.text: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows view-only workspace users to execute queries in restricted environments by supplying an arbitrary environmentId. Attackers can call the data-queries run endpoint for draft app versions to execute queries with stored datasource credentials, exposing development or staging data.

CVE-2026-137532.text: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read cross-workspace files by requesting a known File UUID. Attackers can request GET /api/files/:id with another workspace's File UUID to retrieve stored file bytes, such as avatars, without parent resource authorization checks.

CVE-2026-137520.text: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS is missing the ValidateDataSourceGuard on the dependent-queries route of the data-sources controller and does not scope the datasource lookup to the caller's organization. An authenticated admin or builder with dataSourceDelete can request /api/data-sources/dependent-queries/ to confirm a datasource exists in another organization and learn its dependent-query count.

CVE-2026-137521.text: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated builders to read, modify, or delete other organizations' app-builder components, pages, and events. Attackers can target their own app/version in the URL to pass ValidAppGuard, then supply victim resource ids that services query without appVersionId or organizationId scoping.

CVE-2026-137522.text: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in QueryAuthGuard that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute queries from unreleased app versions. Attackers can POST to the data-queries run endpoint with a draft query ID from any public app to execute unpublished queries against connected datasources.

CVE-2026-137523.text: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authentication bypass in instance-level Google SSO because the id_token audience is not verified when no Google OAuth client ID is configured, the shipped default. Unauthenticated attackers can submit a Google-signed id_token minted for their own OAuth client to /api/sso/sign-in/common/google without an organizationId, obtaining a session as any existing user with the matching email.

CVE-2026-137524.text: ToolJet from 3.20.84 before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the instance-level SSO sign-in path that hardcodes signup as enabled, ignoring all signup-disable controls. Any user with an account on the configured GitHub or Google identity provider can sign in via the OAuth endpoint to obtain an admin session in a newly created workspace.

CVE-2026-137525.text: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows users with TEST_CONNECTION ability to exfiltrate organization secrets by resolving secret placeholders in test-connection options. Attackers can point the host and port at a listener they control and set the password option to a secrets template, causing the server to send the plaintext secret to them.

CVE-2026-137514.text: Nodemailer 9.1.0 before 10.4.1 lowercases recipient domains with JavaScript toLowerCase() in _normalizeAddress before UTS-46 mapping, which converts U+1E9E and word-final U+03A3 differently than WHATWG/UTS-46 validators. An unprivileged attacker can submit an address an application's allow-list approves, causing invites or shared links to reach an attacker-registered domain.

CVE-2026-137515.text: AzuraCast before 0.24.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in RelaysController::updateAction that allows any authenticated user to modify shared relays and delete other stations' relay associations. Attackers can POST a relay base_url to /internal/relays to rename the relay, wipe StationRemote rows of unmanaged stations, and spoof public now-playing data.

CVE-2026-137516.text: AzuraCast before 0.24.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the StationPublicApi middleware that allows any authenticated user to access non-public stations without per-station permissions. Attackers can change the station_id path parameter to list and download on-demand media, read schedule data, and submit song requests to unauthorized stations.

CVE-2026-137517.text: ToolJet from 3.8.0 before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated builders to modify queries in view-only apps by supplying cross-app query IDs. Attackers can send PATCH requests to /api/data-queries/versions/:versionId naming an editable app version with another app's query ID, then run the overwritten query using that app's data source connection.

CVE-2026-137519.text: ToolJet before 3.21.94-beta contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows Builders with only data source Delete permission to update global data sources via the PUT /api/data-sources endpoint. Attackers can change a REST data source base URL so later query executions send stored Bearer credentials to an attacker-controlled endpoint.

CVE-2026-137508.text: Scriban before 7.6.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in object.to_json that allows template authors to bypass the LimitToString string length limit by serializing into an unbounded MemoryStream. Attackers can repeatedly apply object.to_json to escape-heavy strings in a tiny template, amplifying output to multi-gigabyte heap allocations and causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-137509.text: Scriban before 7.6.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows template authors to bypass LimitToString by rendering a ScriptObject with many members. Attackers can supply a small template whose ScriptObject.ToString concatenates large member values without length tracking, allocating multi-gigabyte strings and causing memory exhaustion.

CVE-2026-137510.text: Scriban and Scriban.Signed before 7.6.0 allow template authors to bypass the LimitToString string length limit because the string.literal, string.base64_encode, html.escape, html.newline_to_br, html.url_encode, and html.url_escape builtins lack allocation guards. An attacker who can supply a small template can repeatedly call these builtins under the default TemplateContext to force multi-gigabyte allocations and exhaust host memory.

CVE-2026-137511.text: Scriban before 7.6.0 contains a state isolation vulnerability because TemplateContext.Reset() does not clear the Tags dictionary holding array.cycle and math.random state. Attackers supplying templates to a reused context can observe or influence cycle positions and random sequences across renders, and accumulate unbounded cycle entries to exhaust memory.

CVE-2026-137512.text: Scriban before 7.6.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass LoopLimit by supplying large JSON input to object.from_json. Attackers can pass a flat JSON array or object with hundreds of thousands of elements, which JsonElementExtensions materializes without loop checks, exhausting CPU and memory.

CVE-2026-137513.text: justhtml before 3.17.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in decode_entities_in_text that allows unauthenticated attackers to crash parsing via non-ASCII Unicode digits in numeric character references. Attackers can submit a payload like &#² in HTML text or attributes, causing an uncaught ValueError from int() that aborts JustHTML() and stream() parsing.

CVE-2026-137498.text: Budibase Server from 3.39.18 before 4.0.0 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to erase MongoDB query filters by supplying __proto__ as a dynamic JSON key in PUBLIC queries. Attackers can send a single request to the query execution endpoint, reducing the filter to {} to read, update, or delete every document in the collection.

CVE-2026-137499.text: Budibase from 3.41.0 before 4.0.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to take over password-less global Builder accounts via unverified-email OIDC/SSO account linking. Attackers can assert a victim's email with email_verified=false at a trusted IdP, bypassing the isAccountLinkable allowlist to control all apps, datasources, and automations.

CVE-2026-137500.text: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows non-admin Creator or app-builder users to read pending invite bearer codes via GET /api/global/users/invites. Attackers can submit a stolen code with a chosen password to the public /api/global/users/invite/accept endpoint, hijacking invited identities up to global admin.

CVE-2026-137501.text: Budibase Server before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass in its single-row read and attachment endpoints, which fetch rows by ID without enforcing the requesting view's row filter. Authenticated users with read access to a filtered view can request GET /api/:viewId/rows/:rowId or GET /api/:viewId/rows/:rowId/attachment/:columnName with a hidden row ID to retrieve that row's data and attachments.

CVE-2026-137503.text: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a JSON injection vulnerability that allows attackers to inject JSON structure into S3 delete and Google Sheets row fields via unescaped template parameters. Attackers can submit crafted parameters to the queries endpoint to add extra Key entries, deleting chosen S3 objects or overriding Sheets row columns.

CVE-2026-137504.text: actix-multipart (actix-web) before 0.8.7 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in the MultipartForm extractor that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory or file descriptors by sending unlimited parts. Attackers can stream many zero-byte parts uncounted by total_limit and memory_limit, pinning 128 KiB buffers or opening temporary files to crash workers.

CVE-2026-137505.text: actix-http before 3.20.4 contains a response desynchronization vulnerability in its HTTP/1 client response decoder, which reads bodies on 1xx, 204 and 304 responses based on Content-Length or Transfer-Encoding headers. Servers sending such responses with framing headers cause awc clients to consume subsequent keep-alive responses, causing request failures or misattributing responses across users in proxies.

CVE-2026-137495.text: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the bulkDestroy function that allows authenticated users to delete rows from any workspace table by supplying foreign row IDs. Attackers with TABLE WRITE on one table can send row _id values from other tables to the DELETE /api/:sourceId/rows endpoint, causing data loss and workspace metadata deletion.

CVE-2026-137496.text: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a server-side template injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users with table read permission to execute JavaScript by injecting Handlebars js helpers into row search query values. Attackers can submit base64-encoded JavaScript through the search endpoint, which enrichSearchContext() runs in an isolated-vm sandbox, to read OAuth2 access and refresh tokens of SSO users or cause denial of service.

CVE-2026-137497.text: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve legacy LiteLLM credentials by querying the public settings endpoint. Attackers can send unauthenticated GET requests to /api/global/configs/public to obtain liteLLM.keyId and secretKey, enabling unauthorized use of tenant LiteLLM resources.

CVE-2026-137494.text: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a broken object-level authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users with table write access to reference other tenants' files by supplying arbitrary attachment keys on row save. Attackers can inject a victim app's attachment key into a row, then update or delete the row to delete that object from the shared APPS bucket or read it via presigned URLs.

CVE-2026-137489.text: SurrealDB before 4.0.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the remote HTTP client router that passes raw model names to Url::join during ML export. Attackers can supply an absolute URL as the model name in ExportMl or ExportBytesMl commands to redirect authenticated requests and capture session tokens.

CVE-2026-137490.text: SurrealDB before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows restricted subjects to execute arbitrary queries by calling the JavaScript surrealdb.query() bridge. Attackers permitted to run a specific script can bypass the Capabilities::allows_query() gate in the query module to execute unrestricted queries beyond their predefined operations.

CVE-2026-137491.text: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a query injection vulnerability that allows low-privilege or anonymous users to inject AQL or SQL by supplying unescaped parameters to ArangoDB and Snowflake queries. Attackers can execute published queries with crafted parameter values to bypass filters, read entire datasources, and modify or delete all stored documents.

CVE-2026-137492.text: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows workspace-scoped builders to access other workspaces' backups by supplying a foreign backupId. Attackers can substitute predictable backup IDs in backup download, import, update, or delete routes to steal archives, restore victim data into their workspace, or delete backups.

CVE-2026-137493.text: Budibase server from 3.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows view users and anonymous visitors to access entire base tables by passing a view id to the /api/:viewId/rows routes. Attackers can read, export, modify, and delete rows outside the view filter, including hidden columns, or read the full table unauthenticated through PUBLIC views.

CVE-2026-137483.text: Hono from 4.13.11 before 4.13.18 contains a middleware bypass vulnerability in serveStatic that allows unauthenticated attackers to skip prefix middleware by exploiting a second path decode when allowPercentInPath is enabled. Attackers can send malformed percent-encoded sequences so the router matches an encoded path while serveStatic serves the real file, bypassing authentication checks.

CVE-2026-137484.text: Hono from 4.12.16 before 4.13.18 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in the bodyLimit() middleware that retains every transfer chunk as a separate array. Unauthenticated attackers can send a within-limit request body in one-byte chunks to create millions of retained objects, terminating Bun or Node.js processes.

CVE-2026-137485.text: Hono from 4.5.1 before 4.13.18 contains a validation bypass vulnerability in validator('json') and validator('form') that allows unauthenticated attackers to skip validation by formatting Content-Type parameters differently. Attackers can add whitespace before semicolons, trailing semicolons, or underscored parameter names so validators receive empty objects while handlers still read rejected fields.

CVE-2026-137486.text: Hono from 4.13.16 before 4.13.18 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in mount() and app.mount() that forwards an incorrect path when a custom getPath adds a prefix. Unauthenticated attackers can request crafted paths that the mounted application resolves differently, reaching routes protected by path-scoped middleware such as authentication checks.

CVE-2026-137487.text: OpenWrt LuCI luci-app-unbound through 26.288.56989~75a306d contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because the Unbound Configure page inserts the dhcp.odhcpd.leasetrigger value into a warning notification without escaping. Users with delegated network configuration access can store an HTML event handler in that option through the permitted uci RPC, which executes in an administrator's browser session when the page renders.

CVE-2026-137488.text: SurrealDB before 4.0.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read SELECT-hidden edge endpoints through InOverride/OutOverride error messages. Attackers with CREATE and UPDATE permission on an edge table can re-RELATE an existing edge with mismatched endpoints to recover stored in/out record ids despite row- or field-level restrictions.

CVE-2026-137481.text: Traefik before 2.11.62, 3.x before 3.7.18, and 3.8.0-rc.1 contain an authorization bypass because the sanitizePath entry point option leaves dot-segments carrying path parameters, such as /..;x/, unresolved when matching routers and applying middlewares. Unauthenticated attackers can send requests like /public/..;x/admin to a parameter-stripping backend shared with a protected router, bypassing authentication or authorization middlewares to reach protected resources.

CVE-2026-137478.text: Traefik before 2.11.62, 3.x before 3.7.18, and 3.8.0-rc.1 contain an authentication bypass in the ForwardAuth middleware because connection isolation for NTLM and Negotiate credentials checks only the Authorization header, not Proxy-Authorization. Unauthenticated attackers can send such credentials in Proxy-Authorization to reuse a shared authentication-server connection already authenticated by another user, receive that user's identity via authResponseHeaders, and access backends as that user.

CVE-2026-137479.text: Traefik 3.1.0 before 3.7.18 and 3.8.0-rc.1 contain a memory exhaustion vulnerability in the Compress middleware, which creates zstd encoders with library default options that retain about 18 MiB of state per response until it is fully written. Unauthenticated remote attackers can open many concurrent requests and read responses slowly to exhaust memory and crash Traefik.

CVE-2026-137480.text: Traefik 3.7.15 before 3.7.18 and 3.8.0-rc.1 before 3.8.0-rc.2 contains a client certificate authentication bypass in the Kubernetes Ingress NGINX provider because, on hosts shared by multiple Ingresses using auth-tls-secret, Ssl-Client-* headers are built per Ingress while the TLS handshake uses the first Ingress's settings. Unauthenticated remote attackers can obtain Ssl-Client-Verify: SUCCESS with a client-chosen subject and issuer for an unverified certificate, or inject Ssl-Client-* headers directly, presenting forged identities to backends that trust the proxy.

CVE-2026-137482.text: Traefik before 2.11.62, 3.x before 3.7.18, and 3.8.0-rc.1 before 3.8.0-rc.2 contain a denial of service vulnerability in the BasicAuth middleware, which does not limit password length before MD5-crypt ($apr1$, $1$) hashing. Unauthenticated attackers can send passwords up to the entry point maxHeaderBytes limit (1 MiB by default), consuming excessive CPU per request and degrading availability.

CVE-2026-137472.text: SiYuan from 3.6.2 before 3.8.10 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows admin token holders to read files outside the workspace because the globalCopyFiles and workspaceCopyFiles denylist omits /home, /mnt, /media, and /snap. Attackers can copy other users' SSH authorized_keys, Docker and AWS configs, or mounted files into the workspace and retrieve them via the getFile API.

CVE-2026-137473.text: SiYuan from 3.8.6-beta.1 before 3.8.10 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows read-only publish users (RoleReader) to modify persistent workspace configuration via /api/system/getChangelog. Attackers can send POST requests through the publish service proxy, even anonymously when basic authentication is disabled, to persist ShowChangelog = false to conf.json.

CVE-2026-137474.text: SiYuan 3.8.8 before 3.8.10 contains an incorrect permission assignment vulnerability that creates workspace directories with mode 0755 and conf.json with mode 0644, exposing the cleartext AccessAuthCode administrator credential. Local users able to traverse the SiYuan user's home path can read it and authenticate as administrator via Basic authentication, for example calling /api/system/setAPIToken to change the API token.

CVE-2026-137475.text: vLLM 0.21.0 before 0.28.0, when using the V1 model runner, contains a state aliasing flaw in ThinkingBudgetStateHolder.sync_batch(), whose SWAP branch copies thinking-budget state to the destination batch row without removing the source entry. Attackers submitting requests with thinking_token_budget can force the reasoning-end token sequence into a concurrent co-batched request's output during a mixed batch reorder.

CVE-2026-137476.text: vLLM 0.3.0 before 0.30.0 contains a response amplification vulnerability in the OpenAI-compatible API server's shared RequestValidationError handler, which renders every Pydantic validation error, each of which can include the full offending input, in its HTTP 400 response. Unauthenticated attackers can send a malformed request to endpoints such as POST /v1/responses to trigger a disproportionately large error response that consumes server CPU and memory and can disrupt downstream clients and proxies.

CVE-2026-137477.text: vLLM 0.16.0 before 0.21.0 leaks token data between users when the V1 model runner uses async scheduling with pipeline parallelism, because non-last pipeline ranks never write generated tokens to token_ids_cpu and reset num_tokens_no_spec each step. When the fallback path is triggered, such as by mixed prefill/decode batches, stale tokens from a prior request in the same batch slot become model input and are written to the KV cache, exposing fragments of one user's context in another user's response.

CVE-2026-137466.text: Parse Server before 9.12.0-alpha.2 matches $in, $nin, $all and $containedBy constraints in LiveQuery with a cost proportional to the product of the constraint list size and the saved array size. A client that can subscribe to a class and save objects in it can use large lists and arrays to block the event loop for seconds or longer, stalling LiveQuery and, when it runs in the same process, Parse Server.

CVE-2026-137467.text: SiYuan before 3.8.11 uses DejaVu sync code that accepts a non-hexadecimal 40-byte remote index ID from WebDAV responses and joins it into the repository indexes path unchecked, allowing path traversal. An on-path attacker altering plaintext HTTP WebDAV sync responses can overwrite a workspace data file, such as a .sy note, with compressed index data.

CVE-2026-137468.text: SiYuan from 3.8.0 before 3.8.11 contains a lockout bypass vulnerability that allows remote attackers to brute-force publish passwords by forging client-computable publish-auth- cookies. Attackers can compute SHA-256(ID + candidate) locally and send it on content requests like /api/filetree/getDoc to guess passwords without throttling and read protected documents.

CVE-2026-137469.text: SiYuan 3.7.0 before 3.8.11 contains a DOM-based cross-site scripting vulnerability in the AI agent chat panel, which renders final and saved assistant replies into innerHTML without HTML sanitisation. Attackers influencing model replies via indirect prompt injection or a configured model endpoint can inject event-handler markup, executing OS commands through Node.js integration in desktop local-kernel mode.

CVE-2026-137470.text: SiYuan before 3.8.11 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject DOM event handlers by storing handler-named block attributes such as onmouseover. Attackers can share crafted .sy.zip packages or Markdown files whose attributes reach renderCustom or the unsanitised preview pane, executing OS commands via Node integration in the desktop app.

CVE-2026-137471.text: SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability where WebDAV sync error formatting skips HTML escaping for certain malformed-response errors, passing raw markup to the Electron notification renderer. A network attacker who alters a cleartext HTTP WebDAV response can inject event-handler markup that, when the victim manually starts sync, executes JavaScript with Node integration as the logged-in user.

CVE-2026-137460.text: FreeRDP from 3.10.0 before 3.33.0 contains an invalid free vulnerability in rdg.c because the websocket context pointer shares a union with chunked transfer-encoding decoder state. A malicious RD Gateway answering the data channel with chunked encoding can control the overwritten pointer via chunk sizes, causing rdg_free to free an attacker-influenced value and crash the client.

CVE-2026-137461.text: FreeRDP from 3.0.0 before 3.33.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in cert_write_server_certificate_v1() that computes the proprietary certificate signature over a freed stream buffer after reallocation. Clients negotiating Standard RDP Security with many static channels against servers using 3072- or 4096-bit keys trigger freed heap reads, producing invalid certificate signatures.

CVE-2026-137462.text: FreeRDP before 3.33.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read in WinPR's save_png_to_buffer(), which selects an RGB PNG color type for 9–16 bpp images but fills only 2 bytes per pixel per row. A malicious RDP server can send 9–16 bpp CF_DIB clipboard data that, when a local application requests image/png, yields a PNG containing adjacent client heap memory.

CVE-2026-137463.text: HKUDS nanobot from 0.1.4 before 0.4.1 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in the OpenAI Codex provider that retries authenticated requests without TLS certificate or hostname verification. Attackers able to intercept the connection can trigger a certificate failure and impersonate the endpoint to steal bearer tokens, read request contents, or alter responses.

CVE-2026-137464.text: ImageMagick 7.0.0 before 7.1.2-35 and before 6.9.13-60 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the distributed pixel cache server, which transmits pixel and metadata content in cleartext. Attackers who can observe traffic between a DPC client and server can read transmitted image data.

CVE-2026-137465.text: Parse Server 3.10.0 before 8.6.123 and 9.0.0 before 9.11.1-alpha.4 contains an authentication bypass in the Google Play Games authentication adapter, which does not verify that the supplied player ID belongs to the presented access token. Attackers can sign in with their own Google Play Games credential while claiming another user's player ID to take over that account or link that player ID to their own account.

CVE-2026-137454.text: FreeRDP before 3.33.0 contains an out-of-bounds read in the client smartcard channel because SCARD_IOCTL_LISTREADERSW decoding accepts an odd cBytes value, leaving the mszGroups wide-string buffer without an aligned NUL terminator. A malicious RDP server can send a crafted IRP_MJ_DEVICE_CONTROL request causing the client to read beyond a heap allocation, potentially crashing it.

CVE-2026-137455.text: The FreeRDP proxy in FreeRDP before 3.33.0 dereferences a NULL backend client context in pf_server_refresh_rect and pf_server_suppress_output, which are guarded only by a debug-only WINPR_ASSERT, when a REFRESH_RECT or SUPPRESS_OUTPUT data PDU arrives before connection activation. An unauthenticated remote client that completes licensing without sending Confirm Active can crash the proxy process, terminating all hosted sessions.

CVE-2026-137456.text: FreeRDP before 3.33.0 contains an integer overflow in the client GDI handling of accumulated drawing-order bounds: wrapped INT32 coordinates yield a zero-width clip region that causes clipping to be skipped in gdi_FillRect. A malicious RDP server can send many ORDER_BOUNDS orders followed by an OPAQUE_RECT order to trigger a heap out-of-bounds write past the client's drawing bitmap, potentially leading to code execution.

CVE-2026-137457.text: FreeRDP from 3.0.0 before 3.33.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the shadow server's fast-path input handlers in fastpath.c that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject input before activation. Attackers can negotiate TLS-only RDP, skip Confirm Active, and send Fast-Path Input Event PDUs to inject keystrokes and mouse movement into the host X11 session via XTEST.

CVE-2026-137458.text: FreeRDP from 3.0.0 before 3.33.0 contains a reachable assertion in remdesk_server_thread that allows authenticated clients to abort freerdp-shadow-cli by sending oversized remdesk messages. Attackers can send one message longer than 4096 bytes with a shorter declared PDU length, forcing Stream_Seek past capacity and terminating every served session.

CVE-2026-137459.text: FreeRDP 2.11.2 before 3.33.0 contains unbounded resource consumption in the Progressive codec because progressive_decompress() resets the tile update batch only when frameId changes. A malicious RDP server can repeat RDPGFX_CAPROGRESSIVE WireToSurface2 commands with a constant frameId to cause unbounded memory growth, quadratic CPU cost, a heap out-of-bounds write on tile-cache allocation failure, and client crashes.

CVE-2026-137405.text: A security flaw has been discovered in SourceCodester Online Food Ordering System 1.0. Affected is the function move_uploaded_file of the file /admin/add_food.php of the component File Upload Handler. The manipulation of the argument image/new_image/update_image results in unrestricted upload. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

CVE-2026-137406.text: A weakness has been identified in SourceCodester Syllabus-Aligned Learning Management & Examination System 1.0. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file approve_enrollment.php. This manipulation causes open redirect. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. CVE-2026-137452.text: FreeRDP before 3.33.0 contains a race condition in asynchronous RDPDR IRP processing that allows malicious RDP servers to leak client memory through non-atomic wStream reference count updates. Attackers can send repeated IRPs, such as smartcard redirection requests, so concurrent Stream_Release() calls lose decrements and accumulate unreleased streams, exhausting memory and causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-137453.text: FreeRDP before 3.33.0 contains a credential disclosure vulnerability that allows malicious RDP servers to obtain client passwords because rdp_write_info_packet() omits a Remote Credential Guard check. When a victim connects using /remoteGuard with a configured /p password, the client sends the password in the Client Info packet after CredSSP, exposing reusable credentials to the destination.

CVE-2026-132198.text: The WP Go Maps – Google Map, OpenStreetMap, Leaflet & Store Locator plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'query' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 10.2.05 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. Exploitation requires that the site administrator has enabled the plugin's 'Enable Dynamic SQL Refactors' setting and that the database server is running with a sql_mode containing NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES; neither condition is enabled by default.

CVE-2026-135650.text: The Optimole – Optimize Images | Convert WebP & AVIF | CDN & Lazy Load | Image Optimization plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'author' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.2.20 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This vulnerability is only reachable when the plugin's 'Enable generic placeholder color' option is disabled, as only that configuration invokes the build_url() code path that constructs $low_url from attacker-controlled input.

CVE-2026-137123.text: The WPC Admin Columns plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'form_data (attacker-controlled array keys under wpcac_columns[...])' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.3.8 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation beyond self-XSS requires an administrator to have set the 'Personalized' setting to 'No', which causes column configurations to be stored in a shared option accessible to all users rather than a per-user option.

CVE-2026-126984.text: A **server-side request forgery** flaw has been found in the get_remote_artifact_url() function in pulp_python/app/models.py of the pull-through caching feature in the **pulp_python** package. The function uses the redirect query parameter from the client request as the URL to download. A network attacker or user who can reach the content app of a Python distribution that has a remote can choose that URL. The content app downloads it and returns the response. When the remote has a username and password, the download sends those credentials to the host in the URL. When the remote policy is immediate, the default, or on_demand, the file is saved into the distribution's repository and later clients are served that file. The project name and version come from the file, and the filename comes from the request path. A filename the repository already stores is served from the stored file.

CVE-2026-124072.text: The User Frontend – Membership, User Registration, User Profile, User Directory & Content Restriction with Frontend Post Submission plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'post_title' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.3.14 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires that an administrator has configured a wpuf Post Form with guest post submission enabled and placed its shortcode on a public page, from which an unauthenticated attacker can scrape the required nonce before submitting the malicious payload.

CVE-2026-126342.text: The WPForms (Contact Form by WPForms / wpforms-lite) plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the Multiple Choice field's 'Other' option value on payment forms in all versions up to, and including, 2.0.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a privileged user such as an administrator accesses the injected payment entry on the WPForms > Payments details page. The submitted value is stored via sanitize_text_field(), which preserves a space-separated pseudo-tag (e.g. ' x ') because strip_tags() ignores a ' element retaining its class and data-* attributes, and the bundled Tooltipster initialization (contentAsHTML + contentCloning) then renders the attribute's HTML, executing the script on page load without any hover.

CVE-2026-130332.text: The AWP Classifieds plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'display_name' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.4.10 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The injected payload is stored as a literal entity-encoded string in the WordPress display_name field, which esc_html() passes through without re-encoding due to its double_encode=false behavior, allowing the browser to decode it to raw markup before the JavaScript sink consumes it.

CVE-2026-131803.text: The Mang Board plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'content' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.4.9 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The post-sanitization decode step preserves percent-encoded characters such as %22 through HTMLPurifier, then decodes them to literal double-quotes at render time, allowing an attacker-supplied src attribute to break out of its context and inject event-handler attributes such as onerror into the img tag.

CVE-2026-109921.text: Authentication bypass in the system.setPillar and system.getPillar functions in Uyuni before 5.1.35, 5.2.0 before 5.2.25, 5.3.0 before 5.3.5 could be used by logged in attackers to inject code into other managed system spaces.

This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to extract the plaintext POP3/IMAP mailbox password and username, SMTP configuration, absolute server filesystem paths, and all SQL queries executed during the mail-fetch run from the debug response body. Exploitation requires the site administrator to have enabled the 'Enable Debug Logging' (postie_log_debug) option, which is off by default but is routinely toggled on during troubleshooting and left enabled.

CVE-2026-115512.text: The User Registration & Membership – Free & Paid Memberships, Subscriptions, Content Restriction, User Profile, Custom User Registration & Login Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'form_data (field_name=user_registration_description)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.3.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. CVE-2026-116759.text: The WP Photo Album Plus plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'upn-name' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 9.3.06.002 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires the plugin's Frontend Edit feature to be enabled by the site administrator, which allows photo owners to update photo names via the update-photo-new REST endpoint.

CVE-2026-119153.text: The Swift Performance Lite plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'REQUEST_URI (gated by $_GET['force-cache'])' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.3.7.5 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload is planted via a single unauthenticated GET request to any URL with ?force-cache=1 and a URL-encoded HTML payload in the path, which the plugin decodes and creates as a literal filesystem directory name; the script fires the next time an administrator opens the Swift Performance dashboard.

CVE-2026-119159.text: The Hide My WP Ghost – Security & Firewall plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.0.15 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. CVE-2026-103886.text: The App Builder – Create Native Android & iOS Apps On The Flight plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass via Google ID Token Audience Validation Bypass in all versions up to, and including, 5.7.1. CVE-2026-137119.text: The BuddyForms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the ' [] (array-valued post field)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.10.10 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. CVE-2026-137122.text: The PDF Invoices & Packing Slips for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'billing_address.address_1' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.0.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. CVE-2026-136462.text: The GeoDirectory – WP Business Directory Plugin and Classified Listings Directory plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.8.208 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. Successful exploitation requires that at least one prior comment from the attacker's email address has been manually approved, which under WordPress's default comment_previously_approved=1 setting causes subsequent comments from that address to be auto-approved without moderation.

CVE-2026-136488.text: The GeoDirectory – WP Business Directory Plugin and Classified Listings Directory plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'stype' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.8.208 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. This is possible because the plugin's mu-plugin companion (copied automatically on install when the default 'Enable Fast AJAX' option is on) defines DOING_AJAX on any front-end request carrying gd-ajax=1, and an unconditional branch in geodir_get_current_posttype() restores the attacker-controlled stype value after the allow-list check clears it, allowing the tainted value to reach the SQL sink without any preparation.

CVE-2026-136517.text: The UsersWP – Front-end login form, User Registration, User Profile & Members Directory plugin for WP plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the ' of any editor-type Account field (e.g. about_work)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.2.83 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires that an administrator has configured at least one editor-type Account field with public visibility and directory display enabled, as no such field exists in a default installation.

CVE-2026-136596.text: The GD bbPress Tools plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'signature' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.0.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. The crafted signature payload is stored verbatim in user meta and fires when an Administrator views the attacker's topic on the Edit Topic admin screen.

CVE-2026-136607.text: The GeoDirectory – WP Business Directory Plugin and Classified Listings Directory plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'post_content' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.8.208 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires an administrator to have previously configured a Shortcode-type tab whose template places %%post_content%% inside an HTML attribute, which is not a default configuration; unauthenticated exploitation additionally requires the plugin's 'Allow posting without logging in?' option and WordPress user registration to both be enabled.

CVE-2026-136610.text: The Pixeline’s Email Protector plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires the malicious comment to pass the site's moderation queue, which WordPress enforces for first-time commenters by default but which does not re-sanitize stored comment content.

CVE-2026-135641.text: The WP Job Portal – AI-Powered Recruitment System for Company or Job Board website plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass leading to Account Takeover in all versions up to, and including, 2.7.2 This is due to a flaw in `WPJOBPORTALuser::__construct()` where the non-empty guard on the `wpjobportal-socialid` cookie is evaluated against the raw cookie value before `sanitize_key()` is applied — allowing a value composed entirely of characters outside `[a-z0-9_-]` to pass the guard, be reduced to an empty string by `sanitize_key()`, and be used as the literal value in a `WHERE socialid = ''` database query that matches the first portal account whose `socialid` column is empty. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to be bound to an existing WP Job Portal Employer or Jobseeker account, gaining the ability to create, edit, and delete the victim's companies, job listings, resumes, and applications, as well as overwrite the linked WordPress user's first name, last name, and display name via the `saveuser`→`syncWPUserName()` path. CVE-2026-136240.text: The PDF Invoice for WooCommerce + Drag and Drop Template Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 7.2.0 via deserialization of untrusted input . This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject a PHP Object. No known POP chain is present in the vulnerable software, which means this vulnerability has no impact unless another plugin or theme containing a POP chain is installed on the site. If a POP chain is present via an additional plugin or theme installed on the target system, it may allow the attacker to perform actions like delete arbitrary files, retrieve sensitive data, or execute code depending on the POP chain present. The incomplete remediation in version 7.2.0 applied escape_pdf_note() only to the customer_note path; the billing address path at woocommerce/shortcodes.php:975–978 remains unpatched, and exploitation requires guest checkout to be enabled along with a payment method that transitions orders to on-hold status (such as the stock WooCommerce Direct Bank Transfer option).

CVE-2026-135654.text: The Lightbox with PhotoSwipe plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.18.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires an administrator to approve the attacker's comment at least once, which is the default WordPress behavior for first-time commenters; after that initial approval, no further administrative action is needed and the payload fires for any visitor who opens the lightbox on the affected post.

CVE-2026-135675.text: The RSS Aggregator by Feedzy – Feed to Post, Autoblogging, News & YouTube Video Feeds Aggregator plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in versions up to, and including, 5.2.17 due to insufficient restriction on the wp_kses_allowed_html filter callback. The feedzy_wp_kses_allowed_html() method is registered on wp_kses_allowed_html with the loader's default accepted_args=1, so the callback never receives the context-name argument and unconditionally adds (with arbitrary src, width, height, frameborder, allowfullscreen and data-* attributes) to the allowed-tag array for every context — including pre_comment_content, which WordPress uses to sanitize comment bodies submitted by users without the unfiltered_html capability. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

CVE-2026-136211.text: The Xagio SEO & AEO – AI SEO for Google Rankings & AI Visibility plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'REQUEST_URI' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.1.0.54 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Execution of the injected script requires an administrator to use the plugin's own "Add 301 Redirect" workflow on the attacker's logged 404 row, which causes the entity-laundered double quote to be written into the redirects table and subsequently rendered unescaped in the administrator's browser. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

CVE-2026-136212.text: The LA-Studio Element Kit for Elementor plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'actions[].data.settings.triggers.scrolling_to_selector' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.6.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The elementor_ajax nonce required to reach the handler is printed in elementorCommonConfig on every wp-admin page, making it trivially obtainable by any logged-in Subscriber via /wp-admin/profile.php; although Elementor's attribute escaping is applied at render time, the stored selector value is subsequently passed to jQuery() by the popup frontend script, which re-parses strings beginning with '<' as HTML, bypassing the escaping.

CVE-2026-134173.text: The WordPress File Upload plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Deletion in versions up to, and including, 5.3.1 via the 'wfu_ajax_action_handshake' and 'wfu_ajax_action_send_email_notification' AJAX Actions. This is due to the unauthenticated handshake accepting a 'sid' parameter sanitized only with sanitize_text_field(), which does not strip '[', ']', '{', or '}', allowing the sid to be crafted as an item name containing embedded delimiter pairs that plant forged records for arbitrary other item names — including the per-session file path list and the consent flag — in the plugin's shared concatenated user-state option store, combined with the notification handler being gated only by a nonce freely minted by the same nopriv handshake. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to delete arbitrary files on the affected site's server which may make remote code execution possible.
